title: Desktop UI v1
goal: Arrange and mix by hand in the Electron app, and review and approve an agent plan visually.
prerequisites: M3 protocol and plans; M0 Electron shell.

humanGates.text: Choose the frontend framework (React or Svelte) at the start of M5, as the spec requires.
humanGates.how: The plan phase presents a short comparison; the maintainer decides.

humanGates.text: Review timeline, mixer and plan review usability.
humanGates.how: The maintainer uses the app and lists required changes before the exit check.

features.title: Frontend read model keyed by revision
acceptance: The renderer holds a read model keyed by revision, applies session.changed deltas, recovers with session.sync, and is optimistic only for continuous gestures.

features.title: Timeline with Canvas/WebGL waveforms and clips
acceptance: Clips render from peak pyramids; place, move, trim and remove issue commands; Playwright tests cover each command path.

features.title: Mixer with faders, pan, mute, solo and meters
acceptance: Fader gestures use the parameter channel with leases; one revision per gesture end; meters from binary frames.

features.title: Plan review UI
acceptance: Diff of a plan against the current revision, audition of the branch, approve, reject and partial approve.

exit.how: Playwright scenario plus the maintainer's UX review (human gate).

exit.text: Review and approve an agent plan visually.
exit.how: Playwright scenario with an MCP-submitted plan.
